name: XCC_BC_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS
description: This table stores the configuration of how transaction types, actions affect budgetary control balances

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type defined for budgetary control

columns.name: SOURCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Represents an action performed on a Transaction (e.g. Approve).

columns.name: RESERVATION_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: The reservation category used for that specific action and transaction type. It is the same as the column name in the balances table. It refers to a lookup that would provide a label for reporting.

columns.name: BUSINESS_FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Represents the Business Flow such as Ledger, Procure To Pay, Project Portfolio Management.

columns.name: BUSINESS_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Represents a Business Function.

columns.name: BC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Budgetary control action such as reserve or check.

columns.name: BUCKET_CODE
columns.description: Bucket code to which the resulting budgetary action will post the amount to. It has the same name as the column name in the balances table and it refers to a lookup which can then be used as a reporting label.

columns.name: FORCE_PASS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes/No Flag to indicate whether or not to run that budgetary control action in force pass mode (i.e. won't block even if there isn't enough Funds available).

columns.name: EXTRACT_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the database view that is used to extract the transaction information needed to budgetary control a transaction.

columns.name: BURDENING_EXTRACT_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the database view that is used to extract the burdening information needed to budgetary control a project transaction.

columns.name: REVERSE_SIGN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether or not we need to flip the amount sign.It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: BACKING_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the backing transaction type.

columns.name: LIQUIDATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the type of liquidation (e.g. None, Full or Safe liquidation).

columns.name: RELEASE_UNLIQUIDATED_AMT_FLAG
columns.description: Yes/No flag for non liquidated amount processing.

columns.name: MULTI_BU_FLAG
columns.description: Multi Business Unit indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: USE_BUDGET_DATE_FOR_UNDO_FLAG
columns.description: Code to indicate whether or not to use the budget date for undo processing. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: PRE_BC_HOOK_API_NAME
columns.description: Name of the API to be called by the Budgetary Control Engine prior to perform any action.

columns.name: POST_BC_HOOK_API_NAME
columns.description: Name of the API to be called by the Budgetary Control Engine after performing the requested action.

columns.name: FAILURE_BC_HOOK_API_NAME
columns.description: Name of the API to be called by the Budgetary Control Engine in case of failure.

columns.name: REPROCESS_POST_HOOK_API_NAME
columns.description: Name of API to be called by the budgetary control engine after reprocessing.

columns.name: FAIL_UPON_CLOSE_PENDING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budgetary control should fail when the control budget's period status is Close Pending.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
